name: Descript Studio Sound
tagline: Descript Studio Sound is an AI audio enhancement feature within Descript that transforms voice recordings made in noisy environments into clean, studio-quality audio in one click. It removes echo, background noise, and mic quality inconsistencies, making it essential for podcast editors and video creators.
